name: China (CAAC style, metric)
about: English phraseology in CAAC style with metric altitudes and flight levels. Only the differences from icao.json are listed; anything missing is taken from icao.json. The metric flight level table follows the CAAC RVSM metric level scheme as remembered by the author: VERIFY it against the current CAAC AIP (ENR 1.7) before relying on it.

atc.clearance: {callsign}, {unit}, cleared to {arrival} airport[, {sid} departure], flight planned route, runway {runway}, initial climb {initial_alt}, squawk {squawk}.
atc.descent: {callsign}, descend to {level}[, {star} arrival][, expect {approach} approach runway {runway}].
atc.approach_checkin: {callsign}, {unit}, radar contact, [information {atis} is current, ]descend to {level}[ on QNH {qnh}], expect {approach} approach runway {runway}.

readback.clearance: Cleared to {arrival}[, {sid} departure], runway {runway}, initial climb {initial_alt}, squawk {squawk}, {callsign}.
readback.approach_descent: Descend to {level}[ on QNH {qnh}], expect {approach} runway {runway}, {callsign}.
